title: Lanes can run a second-model-family reviewer before push, recorded as an arm
body:
Source: t-tpkc9xz trial (radar 1), .krn/runs/research/rss-trials/f-g-h-radar.md
Outcome: krn lane accepts an optional pre-push reviewer on another model family, recorded per PR as a Reviewer arm (pattern of src/outcome/lane-advisor.ts), so krn ledger --first-push-green can split by that arm.
Proof: krn ledger --first-push-green split by Reviewer arm prints a verdict over at least 20 PRs per arm.
